pages.text: Repair forged gear at a vanilla anvil with a tempered ingot of the same star or better.$(br2)To salvage it, sneak and right-click a forge's grindstone with it. You get back tempered ingots of its star (some of its metal, more as your Forging improves, less if it's worn) and nuggets for the rest.
pages.title: Repair and Salvage
